text:
olivia: hey everyone, day 1! trying to `git clone git.redwood.local:team/repo.git` but it just hangs. i can SSH to bastion.redwood and from the bastion `git clone git.redwood.local:team/repo.git` works. i'm on macOS Sonoma with the provided WireGuard split-tunnel profile. any quick fixes?

mira: welcome @olivia! quick check: what does `dig +short git.redwood.local` return on your laptop vs the bastion? also which git transport are you using (ssh or https)?

olivia: `dig` on laptop returns nothing, on bastion it returns 10.11.5.7. i'm using SSH transport (git@...).

ben: sounds like split-DNS not being applied to your client. two short-term options: 1) `ssh -J ubuntu@bastion.redwood git@git.redwood.local` (jump host for a single command), or 2) create an SSH local forward so `ssh -L 2222:10.11.5.7:22 ubuntu@bastion.redwood` then `git clone ssh://git@localhost:2222/team/repo.git`.

olivia: i tried the ssh -L trick and cloning via localhost:2222 works. curious if there's a less manual way so i don't have to keep the tunnel open.

mira: for persistence on mac, folks usually either add an `~/.ssh/config` Host entry with `LocalForward` and then use a `launchd` job + `autossh` or rely on an intermittent SSH jump via `ProxyJump`. Example `~/.ssh/config` snippet: `Host git-via-bastion
  HostName bastion.redwood
  User ubuntu
  LocalForward 2222 10.11.5.7:22
` then `ssh -fN git-via-bastion` to background it.

ben: another nice pattern if you want to keep using the normal git URL is `ProxyCommand`/`ProxyJump` so you don't have to rewrite remotes: `Host git.redwood.local
  ProxyJump ubuntu@bastion.redwood
` That way `git clone git@git.redwood.local:team/repo.git` works and SSH will proxy through the bastion automatically.

olivia: oh sweet. ProxyJump made `git clone` work with no extra args. thanks!

mira: quick note on TLS/HTTPS clones: if you use `https://git.redwood.local/...` and the cert is internal, hosts file won't help TLS SANs. tunnel or ProxyJump is the safe option.

olivia: for visibility, what's the long-term fix? will netops change the WG profile?

netops-bot: netops is evaluating pushing the corporate resolver to new-hire WireGuard profiles and adding common internal suffixes (e.g., `*.redwood.internal`) to the split-DNS configuration. will roll out staged updates in the next 48 hours.

mira: thanks @netops-bot. i'll open an onboarding doc PR with the ProxyJump example and a short FAQ: "if DNS for internal hosts doesn't resolve, either use ProxyJump or set up an SSH LocalForward; avoid /etc/hosts for TLS services."

it-bot: created ticket #9855: "Add git.redwood.local to split-DNS + WG resolver push for new hires" assigned to @netops. ETA 1 business day.

ben: FYI for Windows folks: ProxyJump works via OpenSSH too; Windows may need `ssh -J` or updating `C:\Users\\%USERNAME%\\.ssh\\config`. Also if someone prefers a SOCKS proxy: `ssh -D 1080 ubuntu@bastion.redwood -fN` and use `GIT_SSH_COMMAND='ssh -o ProxyCommand="nc -x 127.0.0.1:1080 %h %p"' git clone ...` but ProxyJump is simpler when possible.

olivia: great, ProxyJump solves my flow. i'll keep the ticket open for the resolver patch and make a note in my onboarding checklist. thanks all :smile:
